_doc: P96 adversarial state-ordering & boundary-enumeration check (RESEARCH-ONLY, advisory, UN-WIRED). After the deep pass LOCALIZES a mechanism and the depth-trace COMPLETES (localized_depth_trace.py P92/P94), this is a SECOND gate before a REJECT/harmless/Low may be FINALIZED: it forces the analyst to state the relied-upon invariant and try to BREAK it with concrete adversarial state orderings + boundary cases + actor interleavings. It repairs P95's completed-but-WRONG REJECTs: H-01 executeWithdrawal pro-rata read as locally correct without the closed-market early-execution ordering, and M-05 grantRole provider-vs-provider expiry-bypass false-cleared as a 'trusted control'. P94 guarantees a trace is DONE; P96 guarantees it was ADVERSARIALLY enumerated. It does NOT touch severity_impact_gate (frozen 193abf9f), never sets severity, never converts a REJECT into a finding, never routes. It only decides whether a REJECT may be finalized vs must reopen. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false.
_policy: evaluate(case) decision precedence: (1) relied_upon_invariant empty -> REOPEN_DEPTH_TRACE (must state the invariant being relied on for the REJECT). (2) counterexample_found=true -> PASS_CANDIDATE if counterexample_trace non-empty, else REOPEN_DEPTH_TRACE (a claimed counterexample without a concrete trace is not finalizable). (3) unresolved_ordering_dependency non-empty -> REOPEN_DEPTH_TRACE. (4) inter_principal_trust_boundary=true AND relevant_orderings<min_orderings -> REOPEN_DEPTH_TRACE (an inter-principal boundary, e.g. provider-vs-provider, may NOT be dismissed as a simple trusted control without enumerating orderings; fixes M-05). (5) mechanism_class in mechanism_classes_requiring_3 AND relevant_orderings<min_orderings -> REOPEN_DEPTH_TRACE (a 'locally correct' reject on accounting/lifecycle/role/state-order needs >=3 concrete orderings tried; fixes H-01). (6) needs_execution=true -> NEEDS_EXECUTION if execution_test_idea non-empty, else REOPEN_DEPTH_TRACE. (7) else (guarded_control with no inter-principal boundary, or a fully-enumerated >=3-ordering trace with no counterexample) -> REJECT_CONFIRMED. relevant_orderings = len(ordering_cases_tested)+len(boundary_cases_tested)+len(actor_interleavings_tested). The check NEVER sets severity, NEVER converts a REJECT into a finding, NEVER routes; it only gates whether a REJECT may be finalized vs must reopen the depth trace.
